exposure: maternal prenatal illnesses and medication use
cohort: The cohort comprised 231 patients aged 4-14 years with spastic Cerebral Palsy, whose medical records were analyzed from Xi'an Encephalopathy Hospital.
finding: The study identified neonatal asphyxia (63.20%), premature birth (49.78%), low birth weight (49.35%), maternal prenatal illnesses and medication use (4.76%), cesarean section (32.90% preterm), and environmental pollutants as significant risk factors for spastic Cerebral Palsy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant delivery method and risk factor, present in 32.90% of preterm cases with spastic Cerebral Palsy.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between October 2021 and September 2022.
